Monster Lair.summary: The PC-Engine port of Wonder Boy III: Monster Lair.

Riot Zone.name: Riot Zone
Riot Zone.summary: Riot Zone is a side-scrolling fighting game that follows two heroes as they fight to take down an evil organization. The crime syndicate Dragon Zone has kidnapped Hawk's girlfriend and it's up to him and his partner detective, Tony, to get her back. Join them as they jump "fists first" into the grim Kowloon district.
